items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 11 August 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

East or southeast 2 to 4, occasionally force 5 in places overnight and tomorrow morning, backing east or northeast later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly east or northeast 2 to 4, but locally variable 3 or less, settling south or southwest 2 to 4 overnight into Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then perhaps fog patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally very poor in any fog patches later.
